title: Add mushroom-jazz score-writing skill
description: Create a discoverable companion skill for writing Apricity mushroom-jazz scores. Keep its genre-specific tempo, palette, groove, arrangement, and mix guidance separate from the general score-writing skill, and validate the new skill.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Genre research confirms Mushroom Jazz as Mark Farina's downtempo, dancefloor-friendly blend of jazz, hip-hop, house, R&B, and dubby/organic Bay Area production. The companion skill will translate that identity into flexible score-making decisions, without treating any named artist's recordings as source material or imposing a fixed formula.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implemented a new mushroom-jazz skill with flexible guidance for a warm downtempo blend of jazz, hip-hop, house, soul, and dub: its tempo and pocket, organic source casting, continuous-mix arrangement, restrained effects, and listening criteria. The new skill passes the skill validator and git diff --check.
